description: This PHP script demonstrates how to interact with TestLink's API to create test projects, plans, builds, and platforms via sample client functions. It sets up a test environment with predefined parameters, invoking various API methods through a helper client class.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the XML-RPC server, handling the API requests to TestLink.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project in TestLink using provided configuration and server URL.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan associated with a specified test project.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build associated with a specific test plan.

methods.name: createPlatform
methods.description: Creates a new platform in TestLink and associates it with a test project.
